description: Three men in dark work jackets and hard hats stand around a large cable winch drum on a steel frame, with cables running up over pulley blocks to a tall lattice steel derrick at right. A dramatic overcast sky breaks into golden light, over a flat dark landscape with rails in the foreground. Oil-painting style, edge to edge. No visible text, frame or border. Nothing gory.
reason: Shows workers at a cable winch and lattice derrick under a stormy sky, which is industrial work, not a drought or famine in the Horn of Africa; the card is about the 2011 famine. The equipment also looks older than 2011, so the era is doubtful.
